title: Discoverability
description: Can an agent find the site, its sitemap, its product URLs and its optional index files?

title: Bot access control
description: Do robots.txt, page directives and bot management let the crawlers behind AI answers and the fetchers assistants use get in, and are training decisions stated rather than accidental? Training opt-outs never lose points.

title: Content accessibility
description: Can an agent read product content without executing JavaScript, fetch it whole, trust its status codes, and optionally get it as Markdown?

title: Protocol discovery
description: Does the site publish the agent-protocol discovery documents that exist today (MCP server cards and AI catalog, OAuth metadata, API catalog, A2A card, WebMCP)? Low weight: expected to be absent on most stores.

title: Catalog exposure
description: Can an agent read the catalog as data: the platform API, a public feed, and a sitemap that agrees with them?

title: Product structured data
description: Do product pages carry schema.org Product markup with live price, availability, variants, shipping and returns?

title: Product identity
description: Can an agent match products to real-world entities through GTIN, brand, MPN and SKU, the way Google, Meta, ACP and UCP require?

title: Merchant trust and policies
description: Are the policies a checkout needs (returns, shipping, privacy, terms) and the merchant's identity findable and readable?

title: Checkout and payment protocols
description: Can an agent start a transaction: UCP profile, ACP discovery, Shopify agent surface, guest checkout and cart API?
